data.gender_notes: Mashia is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'sh-a-w-h' which means to help, support, or assist. In Islamic tradition, the name Mashia symbolizes providing guidance, support, and care to those in need. The name Mashia carries the meaning “Help, Support” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mashia usually hope their child will grow to embody help, support and live with faith, good character and purpose.
